name: Tiered bid management

rules.name: Scale proven winners
rules.reason: Converting below target ACoS with enough orders to trust the signal.

rules.name: Rein in hot but proven
rules.reason: The term converts, but above target. Reduce toward target rather than pausing.

rules.name: Warn - reduce before killing
rules.reason: Give the keyword a cheaper chance before switching it off.

rules.name: Kill
rules.reason: Enough spend to conclude the keyword does not convert.

notes: Conditions within a rule are AND-ed.
max_bid is the ceiling the automation may never exceed. It is the primary safety property, more than undo is.
Metrics are SUMMED over lookback_days, not averaged. A longer window makes any threshold easier to trip.
